scope: Stage 3 isolated interactive tutorial, same production engine; no formal state or saves are committed

regression.types: 36 runtime snapshots and negative type checks passed
regression.note: The subsequent native Escape-cancel fix was verified by the final desktop tutorial and normal recovery tests; it does not change engine/model logic.

checks: campaign offers isolated tutorial with explicit presets, scripted opponent and resource explanation
skip returns to the unchanged real campaign draft without a save or military order
confirmation without the required real swap does not advance or mutate the tutorial
native deployment spends one command and preserves the normal summon restriction
clicking a newly summoned unit explains the actual engine restriction
1440px tutorial preserves 5:7 cards and coach stays outside combat hit areas
1000px tutorial preserves 5:7 cards and coach stays outside combat hit areas
800px tutorial preserves 5:7 cards and coach stays outside combat hit areas
rules dialog pauses the scripted opponent without advancing a teaching step
native 5-attack strike leaves target at 5 health and receives simultaneous 3 retaliation
native hero ability pays its real two-command cost
rush cannot bypass a guard to attack a hero on entry
invalid spell target spends no command and does not advance the lesson
targeted temporary spell gives the real displayed +3 attack
end turn expires temporary attack through the shared engine and records the reason
fourteen native player actions complete a real victory with nineteen unique records and no formal settlement
completed tutorial exposes the same read-only detailed battle history
restart reproduces identical people, source ledger and presets without rerolling
restart during deployment cancels old animation and prevents late actions or duplicate dialogs
skipping and animation cleanup leave formal resources, military records and real save keys untouched
military register also offers the isolated teaching entry

presets: Fixed home opening hand and replacement draw
Front visibly preset to 5 attack/10 health; guard visibly preset to 10 health
Target hero visibly preset to 5 health and no armor
Opponent explicitly follows end-turn-only teaching script
limits: Tutorial is ephemeral; reload returns to normal app without resuming lesson.
Phase 1 independent balance and long-run acceptance remain deferred.
